Lurt 0.1.0 is the first release: a light, fast Windows browser written in Rust, with a liquid-glass look.

**Download Lurt:** [Windows (lurt.exe)](https://github.com/ladroxd/Lurt/releases/download/v0.1.0/lurt.exe) · [SHA-256 checksum](https://github.com/ladroxd/Lurt/releases/download/v0.1.0/lurt.exe.sha256)

No installer: download it and run it. Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the app isn't signed; choose **More info → Run anyway**. Needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which Windows 10 and 11 already include.

## New

- **Glass interface.** A borderless window over a blurred backdrop, with translucent tabs and toolbar, rounded page corners and soft animations.
- **Dark, light or system theme.** Pick an accent color, roundness, and a compact one-row layout in Settings.
- **Control the transparency.** Background opacity goes from clear glass to solid, and window opacity fades the whole window, websites included, so you can see your desktop through it.
- **Opens instantly.** The window appears with a skeleton of the interface while the page engine starts, and new tabs show a placeholder instead of a white flash.
- **Light on memory.** About 6 MB to download; new and restored tabs cost nothing until you open them, and idle background tabs go to sleep.
- **Ad and tracker blocking.** Built in, with a per-page count on the shield button; click it to pause blocking on a site.
- **Bookmarks and history.** Searchable in the side panel, with your top sites on the start page.
- **Import from Chrome and Google.** Bring in bookmarks and history from Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi or Opera on your PC, or from a Google Takeout export.
- **Saves passwords and form data.** Lurt offers to remember logins after you sign in once.
- **Mods.** Restyle the browser with your own CSS, and change any website with per-site CSS or JavaScript files.

## Good to know

- Passwords and signed-in sessions can't be copied over from Chrome, because Chrome encrypts them so only Chrome can read them.
- Google is the default search engine; change it in Settings → Browsing.
